candidates.title: The CT spirometer may be reading the diaphragm as a pressure-loaded membrane
candidates.question: Is the Park et al. chest-CT pulmonary-function model using diaphragmatic dome curvature as a mechanical signature of chronic hyperinflation when it predicts FEV1?
candidates.outside_field: Membrane mechanics: pressure, tension, and curvature are linked by the Young-Laplace relation.

rung.move_up: A validated diaphragm-only curvature intervention reaches rung 1; robustness to inspiration, reconstruction, and site gates rung 2; mean principal curvature/diaphragm index supplies the named rung-3 vocabulary.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: The pulmonary-function model is using diaphragmatic dome curvature as an image cue for chronic hyperinflation.

X_measurement.X: Left and right hemidiaphragm dome curvature, summarized by mean principal curvature and the diaphragm index (surface area divided by projected area).
X_measurement.how: Segment the caudal lung-diaphragm interfaces, fit robust quadratic surfaces, compute principal curvatures in physical units, and compute surface-area/projected-area. Chang et al. defined a volumetric CT curvature measurement (PMID 27370142); Bak et al. automated a diaphragm index in 8,431 COPDGene subjects (PMID 39090324).
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes. It is a geometric formula over an automated lung or diaphragm surface and needs no reader label.

candidates.suspected_signal: Long-standing lung hyperinflation shortens and flattens the diaphragm; the network may therefore infer airflow obstruction from a remodeled pressure-bearing boundary rather than from airway or parenchymal disease directly.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Inspiratory effort, scan coverage, prone/supine position, and center-crop framing can change apparent dome geometry without chronic remodeling.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: A runnable version of the Park FEV1 model retains the complete diaphragmatic domes in its exact input tensor, and dome curvature can be altered while lung volume, emphysema, chest-wall geometry, and preprocessing support remain effectively fixed.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Primary sources inspected through PubMed: Park et al. reported CT prediction of pulmonary function (DOI 10.1148/radiol.221488; PMID 36786699); Chang et al. measured CT diaphragm curvature (DOI 10.1118/1.4953451; PMID 27370142); Bak et al. reported an automated diaphragm index associated with FEV1% predicted (PMID 39090324). These establish the adjacent facts, not checkpoint availability or selective-edit validity.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? I have verified that CT models predict FEV1 and diaphragm geometry is measurable; I am still assuming the frozen model sees the domes and that curvature can be changed without changing lung volume or introducing a boundary artifact. That conjunction is load-bearing.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. Correlation between output and curvature is exploratory; only a validated selective intervention can establish model use.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It resembles idea-007 because inspiration changes both respiratory anatomy and model framing. It differs by holding the entire lung tensor fixed and editing only a thin caudal boundary, but it still dies by IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE if curvature cannot be separated from lung volume or edit seams. Annotation provenance does not apply because X is computed.

closest_prior_work.citation: Park et al., Deep Learning-based Approach to Predict Pulmonary Function at Chest CT
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: A chest-CT CNN predicted FEV1 and FVC.
closest_prior_work.delta: The study did not establish use of diaphragm curvature.

closest_prior_work.citation: Bak et al., Automated evaluation of diaphragm configuration based on chest CT in COPD patients
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: An automated diaphragm index was associated with GOLD stage and FEV1% predicted in COPDGene.
closest_prior_work.delta: It measured patient morphology, not reliance by a pulmonary-function model.

closest_prior_work.citation: Chang et al., Three-dimensional quadratic modeling and quantitative evaluation of the diaphragm
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Quadratic surfaces and principal curvature quantified diaphragm shape on volumetric CT.
closest_prior_work.delta: It supplied the measurement but did not decode a neural predictor.

novelty_neighbors.work: Park et al. CT pulmonary-function model
Bak et al. automated diaphragm index
Chang et al. quadratic diaphragm curvature

candidates.novelty_delta: The searched neighbors establish prediction and the curvature biomarker separately; the proposed experiment asks causally whether the frozen predictor uses that biomarker.

why_not_done.detail: Pulmonary-function interpretability has centered on lung volume, emphysema, and airways; the mechanically informative diaphragm is an input boundary that is easy to treat as framing.

candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Freeze the model and test 40-80 public thin-section chest CTs. Warp only a 10-15 mm caudal lung-diaphragm boundary band to flatten or steepen each dome, then restore the original total lung volume by an equal-volume local compensation away from the dome. Require unchanged emphysema percentage, airway Pi10, lung bounding box, and a patch-discriminator equivalence gate. Compare paired FEV1 changes with equal-energy lateral pleural-boundary and phase-scrambled displacement shams.
candidates.compute_envelope: One Colab Pro+ GPU session: at most 80 volumes, one frozen forward model, precomputed segmentations, no model training beyond a small edit discriminator.
candidates.use_vs_association: The use claim requires a dose-ordered paired FEV1 response to curvature-only edits beyond equal-energy boundary shams; an output-curvature correlation alone is explicitly insufficient.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Within-scan edits hold them fixed; repeat the effect across kernel/vendor strata.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Supine-only primary analysis; lung box and volume fixed, but inspiratory-state generalization remains a rung-2 issue.
standing_confounds_addressed.disease_prevalence_referral: Does not explain paired score movement, but limits external interpretation.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage_from_report: No text or labels enter the paired primary readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The model responds to a synthetic caudal edge.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Equal-energy pleural shams, local discriminator equivalence, and bidirectional dose response; not ruled out until these pass.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The edit changes effective lung volume or crop framing.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Exact volume compensation and equality of the final model tensor bounding box.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Curvature is merely emphysema or airway remodeling.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Hold all non-boundary voxels fixed and require stable automated emphysema and Pi10 measurements.

anticipated_negative.reason: After a preregistered large, realistic curvature change and positive-control sensitivity, equivalence of FEV1 output would directly weaken appreciable use of this X.

cross_domain.measurement_implied: Principal curvature in mm^-1 and surface/projected-area ratio.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would become generic diaphragm occlusion; membrane mechanics dictates curvature-preserving volume controls and directional flattening/steepening.

candidates.remaining_legwork: Inspect exact checkpoint/input availability first; then one day for coverage counts and 3-5 days for edit-validity pilots.

clarity.why: One frozen output, one geometric X, and a directional intervention.

identifiability.why: Non-boundary anatomy is fixed and explicit edge/volume shams address the leading rivals; edit realism remains.

medical_relevance.why: It would distinguish a mechanical hyperinflation cue from direct airway/parenchymal measurement.

interest.why: A CT spirometer reading a pressure-loaded boundary is surprising and legible.

prior_legwork.why: The predictor and two quantitative diaphragm methods already exist.

feasibility.why: Capped because checkpoint visibility and selective editing are not inspected.

data_readiness.why: A public compatible checkpoint/cohort conjunction is not confirmed.

evaluation_readiness.why: Curvature, volume, emphysema, Pi10, and paired output are defined.

negative_result_value.why: A gated equivalence result is decisive for this X.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; a bounded primary-source search found no model-use audit.

regret.why: The boundary is routinely retained and may be an overlooked dominant cue.

unverified_claims: Its exact tensor retains both diaphragmatic domes
A curvature-only edit can pass the distribution gate
No prior causal audit tested this X

candidates.title: Mirai may be detecting broken bilateral symmetry before a lesion exists
candidates.question: Is Mirai using left-right mammographic parenchymal asymmetry as a field-effect cue for future breast cancer?
candidates.outside_field: Developmental biology and quality-control engineering: bilateral organs provide an internal matched reference, and symmetry breaking is a sensitive deviation signal.

rung.move_up: Contralateral homologous-patch equalization plus a natural bilateral dose response reaches rung 1; view/vendor/positioning replication gates rung 2; bilateral parenchymal asymmetry supplies rung 3.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: Mirai is using bilateral parenchymal asymmetry as an image marker of breast-cancer risk.

X_measurement.X: A bilateral parenchymal asymmetry index: the multiscale difference in density, local ridge orientation, and texture energy between deformably registered left-right homologous breast regions, computed separately for CC and MLO views.
X_measurement.how: Reflect one breast, register breast outline/nipple/pectoral coordinates to its contralateral mate, compute homologous patch differences at prespecified spatial scales, and aggregate robustly while excluding the pectoral muscle and skin line.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes. Registration and pixel-derived density/texture differences are deterministic and require no semantic annotation.

candidates.suspected_signal: A future-cancer breast may depart subtly from its contralateral developmental control through field change, involution, occult architectural distortion, or asymmetric tissue aging before a discrete lesion is called.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Unequal compression, positioning, exposure processing, prior unilateral surgery, and natural constitutional asymmetry can all manufacture the index.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: After view-specific deformable registration and positioning-quality gates, the asymmetry index is repeatable across serial negative exams and can be selectively reduced in one breast without erasing focal lesions, changing global density, or producing a registration-looking artifact to Mirai.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Primary sources inspected through PubMed: Mirai predicts 1-5-year risk across international cohorts (PMID 33504648); Wang et al. computed bilateral tissue asymmetry for future-risk prediction (DOI 10.1016/j.medengphy.2011.03.001; PMID 21482168); a later near-term study again used computerized bilateral features (PMID 24725671). None proves repeatable X or a valid Mirai intervention.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? I have verified that bilateral asymmetry predicts risk and Mirai predicts risk; I am still assuming the asymmetry is stable beyond positioning and can be changed without deleting occult disease or creating a synthetic cue. That is the real keystone.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. Existing asymmetry-risk prediction is association; a selective paired intervention is necessary for model use.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It shares idea-015's Mirai model but not its BAC, vascular-age claim, or required calcium mask, so it is not a revival. It risks IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE from compression/positioning and fails unless serial and cross-view repeatability gates pass. Annotation provenance does not apply because X is pixel-computed.

closest_prior_work.citation: Yala et al., Toward robust mammography-based models for breast cancer risk
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Mirai predicted risk at multiple horizons and generalized across MGH, Karolinska, and CGMH.
closest_prior_work.delta: The report did not establish reliance on bilateral asymmetry.

closest_prior_work.citation: Wang et al., Computerized prediction of risk based on bilateral mammographic tissue asymmetry
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Twenty bilateral features supported near-term risk classification.
closest_prior_work.delta: It built an asymmetry predictor rather than decoding Mirai.

closest_prior_work.citation: Zheng et al., Prediction of near-term risk using computerized features from bilateral mammograms
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Global bilateral asymmetry predicted abnormalities or cancer at the next screen in a small cohort.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not test a modern long-horizon risk network or causal use.

novelty_neighbors.work: Wang et al. bilateral asymmetry risk scheme
Zheng et al. near-term bilateral feature prediction

candidates.novelty_delta: Prior work shows that asymmetry itself predicts risk, but the proposed study asks whether Mirai's score causally depends on a preregistered asymmetry index after density and focal content are held fixed.

why_not_done.detail: A released multi-view, multi-horizon model plus modern dense registration and tissue-preserving image translation now permit model-self-comparison rather than training another asymmetry classifier.

existing_assets: Paired bilateral CC/MLO inputs intrinsic to screening
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: On 100 public four-view screening exams, register contralateral homologous tissue. Replace only the low-frequency-normalized parenchymal residual of one high-asymmetry patch with a convex blend toward its mirrored mate, excluding any region flagged by an independent lesion detector. Preserve breast outline, global density histogram, and power spectrum. Test a dose series against same-breast patch shuffles, left-right label swaps, and equal-energy nonhomologous blends; require concordant Mirai changes in CC and MLO.
candidates.compute_envelope: One Colab Pro+ GPU session: 100 exams, frozen Mirai inference, cached registration, no outcome-model training.
candidates.use_vs_association: Use is supported only if selective asymmetry equalization moves Mirai risk monotonically beyond spectrum- and energy-matched shams; natural asymmetry-risk correlation is exploratory.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Within-exam edits hold these fixed; vendor-stratified replication tests generality.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Cross-view concordance, nipple/pectoral registration, and serial repeatability are mandatory; unequal compression remains the kill gate.
standing_confounds_addressed.body_habitus: Contralateral self-control and fixed breast outline/density reduce habitus effects.
standing_confounds_addressed.disease_prevalence_referral: Primary model-self-comparison is label-free; screening spectrum still limits scope.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage_from_report: No reports or outcomes enter the primary readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Mirai detects generic blending or registration artifacts.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Equal-energy nonhomologous and same-breast shams plus a blinded edit discriminator.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The edit removes an occult focal lesion rather than asymmetry.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Exclude independent lesion-detector regions and repeat using diffuse low-amplitude patches only; residual occult disease cannot be fully excluded.
Require CC/MLO and serial consistency; failure is fatal to the biological claim.

anticipated_negative.reason: If a validated dose series substantially reduces X while Mirai risk remains within a prespecified equivalence margin, appreciable use of this defined X is weakened.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Bilateral fluctuating asymmetry from developmental biology, used as an internal-control signal of perturbation.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: Registered left-right homologous tissue differences, not unilateral texture entropy.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The study would perturb generic texture; bilateral symmetry uniquely dictates the matched contralateral reference and cross-view consistency tests.

candidates.remaining_legwork: Two days to inspect Mirai's preprocessing of laterality and four-view fusion; 3-5 days for registration repeatability and edit-discriminator pilots.

clarity.why: The model, bilateral X, and equalization operation are explicit.

identifiability.why: Matched shams isolate asymmetry response, but compression and occult lesions remain serious rivals.

medical_relevance.why: If true, asymmetry could explain risk and expose sensitivity to unilateral positioning or surgery.

interest.why: The contralateral breast acting as the model's hidden control is broadly compelling.

prior_legwork.why: Mirai and multiple bilateral-risk studies already exist.

feasibility.why: Capped because intervention validity is uninspected.

data_readiness.why: Public four-view mammograms and Mirai are available, though preprocessing compatibility needs audit.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired score, X-dose, density preservation, and shams are defined.

negative_result_value.why: A gated equivalence result is decisive for the specified X.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; close asymmetry literature makes the gap precise but not verified exhaustive.

regret.why: Bilateral inputs are already present, making this an unusually cheap explanation audit.

unverified_claims: Mirai fuses laterality in a way that permits this audit
The asymmetry index is serially repeatable
Equalization can preserve occult focal content and input distribution
No prior paper causally tested Mirai's use of bilateral asymmetry

candidates.title: The glioblastoma prognosticator may be reading the invasion front's roughness
candidates.question: Is a whole-brain glioblastoma survival model using the fractal roughness of the T2/FLAIR abnormality boundary as an image signature of infiltrative growth?
candidates.outside_field: Invasion ecology and reaction-diffusion physics: a spreading front's geometry records heterogeneity in dispersal and substrate resistance.

rung.move_up: A volume- and intensity-preserving boundary-roughness intervention reaches rung 1; sequence/site and edema-mechanism controls gate rung 2; boundary fractal dimension/lacunarity supplies rung 3.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: The glioblastoma survival model is using fractal roughness of the peritumoral T2/FLAIR abnormality boundary as an image marker of infiltrative growth.

X_measurement.X: Multiscale box-counting dimension and lacunarity of the 3D T2/FLAIR abnormality boundary after surface-area and volume normalization.
X_measurement.how: Use an automated glioma segmentation, extract the edema/FLAIR surface, estimate box counts over preregistered physically resolvable scales, and compute lacunarity on the boundary occupancy map; report stability to voxel size and segmentation perturbation.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes. Existing automated tumor segmentation plus explicit geometric formulas suffice; no radiologist rating is needed.

candidates.suspected_signal: An irregular, multiscale edema front may reflect anisotropic invasion along white-matter tracts or spatially heterogeneous vascular permeability, giving a survival network information beyond lesion volume.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Voxel anisotropy, skull stripping, edema-segmentation error, treatment-related change, and sequence resolution can create or erase boundary roughness.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: The exact whole-brain survival model is runnable on T2/FLAIR inputs, and boundary fractal dimension can be varied over resolvable scales while total abnormality volume, surface area, intensity histogram, distance to ventricles/cortex, and model-input distribution remain fixed.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Primary full text/search records inspected: GRASP used whole-brain post-radiotherapy T1c and T2 MRI and achieved amalgamated-test AUC 0.93 (DOI 10.1093/neuonc/noae017; PMID 38285679; PMCID PMC11145448); Tate et al. found edema fractal dimension prognostic (PMID 34853344); Schoenegger et al. reported prognostic edema extent (DOI 10.1111/j.1468-1331.2009.02613.x; PMID 19473360). None establishes a runnable checkpoint plus selective boundary edit.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? I verified that a whole-brain model predicts survival and roughness is prognostic. I am still assuming the checkpoint is obtainable and a roughness-only edit can preserve volume, surface area, location, intensity, and treatment appearance. That is the load-bearing conjunction.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. Published prognostic association does not show the network uses X; the perturbation gate is essential.
candidates.dies_like_prior: No annotation-provenance failure applies because segmentation and X are automated. It risks the portfolio's recurrent USE_VS_ASSOCIATION error; the proposed boundary intervention is what makes it different. It dies by IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE if smoothing necessarily changes surface area, anatomy, or treatment-related texture.

closest_prior_work.verified_fact: A whole-brain post-radiotherapy MRI model predicted 8-month survival across multiple centers.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not identify edema-boundary roughness as a used signal.

closest_prior_work.citation: Tate et al., Shape matters: morphological metrics of glioblastoma imaging abnormalities
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Fractal dimension and lacunarity of GBM abnormalities, especially T2/FLAIR edema, were associated with survival.
closest_prior_work.delta: It tested a handcrafted prognostic biomarker, not model reliance.

closest_prior_work.citation: Schoenegger et al., Peritumoral edema on MRI at initial diagnosis
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Edema extent was evaluated as an independent prognostic factor.
closest_prior_work.delta: It addressed extent, not multiscale boundary roughness or neural-model use.

novelty_neighbors.work: Tate et al. fractal/lacunarity GBM morphology

candidates.novelty_delta: The neighbors establish a strong whole-brain predictor and a prognostic fractal biomarker separately; the delta is a controlled use test that preserves edema amount and intensity while changing only resolvable boundary roughness.

why_not_done.detail: Interpretation work typically localizes attention or correlates radiomics with output; it rarely constructs geometry-matched counterfactuals that distinguish boundary organization from edema volume.

existing_assets: GRASP architecture and multicenter full text
Public glioma MRI and automated tumor segmentation
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: On 50-75 public post-treatment glioblastoma MRIs, generate paired signed-distance-field edits that exchange fine-scale boundary protrusions and indentations while exactly matching lesion volume, surface area, centroid, ventricular/cortical distance distribution, and within-mask T2 histogram. Test survival-score response across three resolvable scale bands against rigidly rotated boundary-displacement and intensity-only shams. Preserve an untouched test set and preregister an output-equivalence margin.
candidates.compute_envelope: One Colab Pro+ GPU session: at most 75 volumes, one frozen predictor, CPU-side signed-distance edits, cached segmentations, and batched inference only.
candidates.use_vs_association: Use requires scale-specific, dose-ordered score changes under roughness-only edits beyond geometry- and energy-matched shams; score-fractal correlation alone remains exploratory.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Within-scan perturbations hold them fixed; repeat by sequence resolution and site.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Rigid within-scan geometry makes positioning irrelevant to the paired estimand.
standing_confounds_addressed.body_habitus: Not a material brain-MRI alternative and fixed within scan.
standing_confounds_addressed.disease_prevalence_referral: Cannot explain paired output change but limits generalization.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage_from_report: No reports or survival labels enter the primary paired readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The model responds to interpolation or segmentation seams.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Rotated-displacement shams, boundary-band discriminator, and multiple interpolation kernels.

alternative_explanations.alternative: It uses surface area or edema volume, not fractal organization.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Match both exactly in physical space and verify after final preprocessing.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Roughness represents radiotherapy change rather than invasion.
alternative_explanations.resolution: The intervention can establish use of X but not its biological meaning; pretreatment replication or treatment-stratified evidence is required for rung 2/3 gloss.

anticipated_negative.reason: If validated edits span the natural X range while preserving rival geometry and the frozen output stays within an equivalence margin, appreciable use of boundary roughness is weakened.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Rough invasion fronts from reaction-diffusion ecology.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: Scale-resolved boundary fractal dimension and lacunarity, rather than generic radiomic texture.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would smooth lesions arbitrarily; invasion-front theory requires scale-specific roughness edits and separates front geometry from occupied volume.

candidates.remaining_legwork: First inspect released GRASP weights and exact preprocessing; then 2-3 days for segmentation/scale stability and roughly one week for counterfactual validation.
